card.name: Linking marks inside fluorouracil-leucovorin combinations
card.fires_on: The small joining mark or word (slash, hyphen, 'and', 'or', opening parenthesis) right after fluorouracil, fluoropyrimidine or leucovorin in colorectal cancer chemotherapy regimens.

modes.label: Slash or hyphen
modes.description: A slash or hyphen joining fluorouracil to leucovorin or irinotecan.
modes.example: Administer oxaliplatin for injection in combination with 5-fluorouracil<</>>leucovorin every 2

modes.label: And / or after leucovorin
modes.description: A linking word after leucovorin or fluorouracil that leads to the next drug in the regimen.
modes.example: ouracil, administered in an infusional regimen in combination with leucovorin alone, or in combination with leucovorin<< and>> oxaliplatin or irinotec

modes.label: Parenthesis before abbreviation
modes.description: An opening parenthesis after leucovorin that introduces the abbreviation LV.
modes.example: ( 7.3 ) 7.1 5-Fluorouracil (5-FU) and Leucovorin<< (>>LV) In a phase 1 clinical

card.writes: No clear meaning from the promoted and suppressed tokens; they look unrelated.
